basics.name: Nithin Gopalakrishnan Nair
basics.label: Research Engineer
basics.summary: My research focuses on large-scale model training, generative modeling, multimodal learning, synthetic data, and 3D understanding.

work.name: Apple
work.summary: Designed an auto-improvement pipeline to improve the performance of long-horizon agents on human interaction understanding tasks.
highlights: Owned agent development infrastructure, integrating simulation and evaluation workflows.
Defined evaluation protocols and scoring rubrics to assess the quality and behavior of multimodal agents and guide model improvements.

work.name: Google Beam (Hosts: Jungyeon Park, Srinivas Kaza)
work.summary: Designed a novel transformer architecture for scaling novel view synthesis using diffusion-generated views (ICCV 2025; patent application filed).
highlights: Achieved state-of-the-art novel view synthesis on Re10K, ACID, and DL3DV, and improved cross-dataset generalization using synthetic training data.

work.name: Deep Imagination Research, NVIDIA (Mentors: J.P. Lewis, Ming-Yu Liu)
highlights: Built a zero-shot pipeline to segment 3D mesh parts and estimate materials and physical properties using multi-view foundation-model features and multimodal reasoning (U.S. Patent Application 19/024,394).

work.name: Adobe Inc (Mentor: Yuqian Zhou)
work.summary: Developed Control2Control for training-free image editing from sketches, poses, and layouts.
highlights: Designed a novel attention transfer method for identity-preserving editing using human-drawn control signals.

work.name: Mitsubishi Electric Research Labs (Mentors: Tim Marks, Anoop Cherian)
work.summary: Developed Steered Diffusion, an energy-based approach for zero-shot conditioning of diffusion models through inference-time guidance (ICCV 2023).
